prompt: Revisa los prompts de extracción del Brand Studio. Quiero saber si cuando extraemos la marca de un sitio web, los prompts capturan la información al nivel atómico correcto o si producen datos demasiado genéricos.

assertions.text: Reads and analyzes all 10 brand_extract_*.j2 templates (identity, story, positioning, narrative, strategy, authority, people_contact, testimonials, visuals, communication_assets)
For each prompt, evaluates whether it produces specific, usable data vs vague/generic output. Gives concrete examples of what 'too generic' looks like.
Cross-references each prompt against the marketing framework it should serve (e.g., positioning prompt vs Brand Love Key, narrative prompt vs StoryBrand)
Identifies concrete weaknesses in at least 3 prompts — not just 'could be better' but specific instructions that are missing or poorly framed
Evaluates whether prompts use plain language that would produce user-friendly output while internally mapping to methodology concepts
